task: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) are hard and match "open the door, then pick up the box". Together they force door_open, so no separate Existence is needed. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches the soft "try not to drop the key while the door is still closed", since key_lost is already defined as a drop with the door closed.

texts: Pick up the target box (the mission's box in the other room) at some point before the episode ends.
Open the door before the agent picks up the target box, so the box pickup comes only after the door is open.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, which is the key_lost event.
